description: The per-call time limit (context.timeLimitMs, ScriptHost.TimeLimitMs). The VM checks the clock every 10,000 instructions, and long library loops (pattern matching, table.sort, table.concat, string.rep) every 10,000 steps, so the outcome is the same on every host; only the time it takes differs.

cases.name: a short call returns
cases.source:
local n = 0
for i = 1, 1000 do n = n + i end
return n

cases.name: one long library call is interrupted
the context works after an interruption
